rationale: The candidate is a coherent four-view mass with a readable dominant wedge/roof gesture, but it is too close to a compact hall-object and does not yet fully support the neighborhood-living brief. The road frontage edge is not strongly activated in the visible massing; the model shows little public void, undercut, or entry seam responding to the verified access edge. The overall form is consistent across views, so repair integrity is acceptable, but the program relation remains weak because the section reads as a sealed prismatic object rather than a mixed-use street building with an active ground threshold and one clear public court/terrace. The references support a transferable principle of keeping one dominant mass while carving a meaningful void or public threshold, but the candidate has not yet achieved that relationship.
